https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cqj9xk.text: People escape historic Kyiv building hit by Russian drone People escape historic Kyiv building hit by Russian drone Close Ukraine's National Academy of Sciences has been hit by a Russian drone strike, killing one person and leaving three injured, according to city's mayor Vitaliy Klitschko. Footage showed people leaning out of windows as they evacuated the burning building. Firefighters helped people evacuate through the windows as a plume a black smoke billowed out of the building. The BBC's diplomatic correspondent Paul Adams was at the scene as emergency services attempted to stop the raging fire. https://www.newsx.com/world/3-indians-in.text: At least three Indians were killed and five others injured after a fire broke out at a residential building in Bochum, Germany, early Tuesday. Police have arrested a 41-year-old resident on suspicion of murder as investigators examine whether the deadly blaze was deliberately set. The victims were two women aged 25 and 27 and a 26-year-old man, German public broadcaster WDR reported, citing Bochum police. Their identities and home states in India have not yet been disclosed. Three Indians Found Dead After Early Morning Fire in Bochum The fire broke out around 4.15 am local time on Tuesday in a multi-family residential building in the Hofstede district of Bochum. Emergency services rushed to the scene, where firefighters discovered the three victims dead inside an apartment on the second floor. Five other people suffered smoke inhalation and were taken to hospitals in Bochum. Their nationalities have not been disclosed. Flames Spread Through Stairwell, Making Rescue Difficult The rescue operation became challenging as flames spread upwards through the building's stairwell. The intense fire prevented firefighters from using the staircase to reach residents on the upper floors, WDR reported. According to a German Press Agency (DPA) report carried by n-tv, firefighters rescued two people using a turntable ladder, two others with portable ladders and another person with a safety cushion. The incident has raised serious questions about how the fire started and whether it was intentionally triggered. 41-Year-Old Romanian National Arrested on Murder Suspicion A 41-year-old Romanian national was arrested, according to an announcement made by the police and prosecution on Wednesday. As per the spokesperson for Bochum Police, there are initial indications to believe that the suspect is involved in murder. Members of the homicide squad interrogated the suspect in connection with this investigation. Investigators Suspect Arson, But Cause Remains Unconfirmed Technical problems have been ruled out as the cause of the fire, while arson has been suspected. Nevertheless, the authorities continue to look into whether the fire was intentional or accidental. The arrest of the suspect in the case represents a major breakthrough for the investigation, although the exact cause of the fire and the deaths of the three Indian nationals have not yet been determined.

Edited by: Alex Berry https://p.dw.com/p/5PXGe Skip next section Ukraine's Zelenskyy confirms strike on Kerch bridge 11/17/2026 November 17, 2026 Ukraine's Zelenskyy confirms strike on Kerch bridge Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has confirmed that the Kerch bridge was targeted by Ukrainian forces, describing it as "an unprecedented operation in response to Russian strikes on our infrastructure." "Today, everyone can see the consequences for the main military crossing from Russian territory into our Ukrainian Crimea," Zelenskyy said in a lengthy post on social media platform X. The Ukrainian leader said the strike was a culmination of an operation "carried out over several weeks" by his country's military and involved destroying air defense systems, radar systems and electronic warfare equipment in the lead up to the attack. Zelenskyy said that the road section of the bridge was hit by "Palianytsia" drones and while the railway section was targeted by "Neptune" missiles and "Ruta" drones. "We have repeatedly offered Russia steps toward de-escalation — and every proposal has been met with loud rejection," Zelenskyy said and pointed to continued Russian strikes on Ukraine's infrastructure. His post was accompanied by footage appearing to show the moment the bridge was struck and then the subsequent aftermath with one part of the bridge collapsed. "Russia is intensifying its air attacks because it is not making progress on the battlefield," Defense Minister Boris Pistorius said at an EU meeting in Brussels. Pistorius said that Germany would contribute $300 million (€272 million) towards the weapons package that would include Patriot interceptor missiles. The package will also include previously announced IRIS-T systems, as well as new radars and ammunition for F-16 fighter jets and drones. The announcement comes ahead of a meeting of Ukraine's military backers at NATO headquarters in Brussels later today. Germany has, since the start of Russia's invasion, provided civilian aid totalling more than €45.7 billion and provided or earmarked military aid of around €57.8 billion, according to the German government . The route is a major source of supplies for Russian forces in Ukraine's occupied Kherson region and is a strategically significant target for Ukrainian forces. Photos on various Telegram channels appear to show that one of the arches and part of the roadway have collapsed following a strike. Poland's Foreign Minister Radoslaw Sikorski shared a picture on his X account showing a single arch where there should be two, simply exclaiming "Wow." Reports on the extent of damage have yet to be confirmed by official sources, but images and videos of the bridge are being widely circulated in the Ukrainian media space. Russia's Transport Ministry said there had been an overnight drone strike on November 17 leading to a temporary suspension of traffic. It advised motorists not to travel towards the bridge and wait for further information. Four people were still missing after authorities concluded a two-week search operation on Monday. Russia hit a former school that was used as an aid distribution center in Komyshuvakha on November 2 as people were collecting humanitarian supplies. The attack was one of the deadliest of the war. The village is located close to the frontline. Ukrainian police said Russia had attacked the search operation several times during the past two weeks. "Unfortunately, the shelling of Komyshuvakha on November 2, 2026, became one of the most tragic attacks since the beginning of the full-scale war," Ukraine's national police said. Edited by: Roshni Majumdar https://p.dw.com/p/5PWS2 Skip next section Ukraine holds new talks with US, European negotiators 11/17/2026 November 17, 2026 Ukraine holds new talks with US, European negotiators Volodymyr Zelenskyy met with US envoys Jared Kushner (left) and Steve Witkoff in Dublin last week Image: Peter Morrison/AP Photo/dpa/picture alliance Ukraine held fresh talks with US and European negotiators on ending the war with Russia on Monday evening, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said. Ukrainian officials held online talks with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, as well as representatives from Ukraine's European partners. Kushner said progress had been made towards an agreement, although significant challenges remain to finding a path to peace. The online talks come less than a week after delegations from the US, Ukraine and Russia met in Abu Dhabi for their first trilateral talks in nine months. "Diplomatic processes are ​actively underway and we hope that these efforts will not be ​in ‌vain," Zelenskyy said. "Our team is working in the most constructive manner possible." In his nightly video address, Zelenskyy also warned that Kyiv had intelligence that Russia would launch major strikes on targets across Ukraine on Monday evening and into Tuesday. The Ukrainian leader warned that Russia "must know that for every act of evil they commit, there will be a just response from us." In his remarks, Zelenskyy cited a Ukrainian intelligence report that said North Korea was supplying "dozens of ballistic missiles to Russia each month." "This is extremely dangerous and not ​only for Ukraine," he said. "By ⁠using its ballistic missiles in this war, North Korea is making its weapons more effective. ⁠This creates additional challenges ​for the entire region around Korea." "At the moment, traffic is suspended," Crimea's Moscow-installed governor, Sergey Aksyonov said Tuesday. Russian officials also said Ukraine had struck oil refineries on Monday. Overnight into Tuesday, Ukraine targeted Moscow with nearly 200 drones. Moscow mayor Sergey Sobyanin said early Tuesday morning that Russian air defenses had downed 20 drones heading towards the capital.
